simple.summary: צוּף (tsûwph) means comb of honey (from dripping) First listed occurrence: Prov 16 24.

definitions.full: H6688. tsuph I. צוּף noun masculine (honey-)comb (as exuding honey); — only figurative: construct צוּףדְּֿבַשׁ Prov 16:24 ; plural צוּפִים נֹפֶת Psa 19:11 (+ דְּבַשׁ ), ᵐ5 κηρίον , κηρία , ᵑ9 favus .
